children: Greenland Mines entered into an amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger to finalize terms of its acquisition structure. The amendment substitutes NNSR Holdings as the counterparty in place of Neo and fixes the equity consideration at 1,040,676 newly issued common shares and 359,324 newly issued Series R preferred shares. The changes align the transaction mechanics ahead of closing and support the company’s strategy to advance the Sarfartoq rare earth project.
: Amendment to Agreement and Plan of Merger
: NNSR Holdings and Neo North Star Resources
